... Petitioner/s  Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Veena Devi W/o Radheykant Bhandari R/o Village- Bishanpur, P.S.-
 Lakhnaur, District- Madhubani, at present Veena Devi, C/o Pramod Kumar  Bhandari, R/o village- Parsa, P.S.- Ghoghardiha, District- Madhubani  ...

... Opposit  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Jitendra Kumar Bharti  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Tiwary  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 5 09-11-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State but, in spite of valid service of notice, none is present on behalf of opposite party no.2.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 498A & 379/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.47214 of 2022(5) dt.09-11-2023 committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.

The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar,
reported in 2006 (3) PLJR 182.
